tieInformedPassingHitBounds.meaning: Minimum and maximum possible passing-hit counts among the highest reported-score ties; crystal-informed bounds, not prospective selection.

definitions.confidence: Archived reported ipTM, with lowest seed breaking ties, without crystal or diagnostic filtering. The pinned upstream archive writer rounds summary confidence to two decimals; this does not reconstruct unrounded model confidence.
definitions.diagnostics: Existing limited stereochemical-identity and severe protein–ligand clash checks. Categories describe observations; they do not establish the cause of a miss.
definitions.backbone: All observed corresponding C-alpha atoms in the existing scoring frame. A small global C-alpha RMSD does not certify the binding pocket or local geometry.
definitions.failures: All planned cases remain in the denominator, including failed executions. Unfinished prefixes are rejected.
definitions.scope: Selected native-positive reconstruction cohort with related cases, unmatched native/browser preparation and sampling, and reconstructed native ligand topology. Not implementation parity or general predictive accuracy.
